checks.claim: Event 56 (Dec 17-20) and Event 59 (Dec 20-23) row details vs structure sheets 35, 36 and 4
checks.observed: Read live 2026-11-17. Sheet 35 (56 Days A+C+E): Level Duration 40 minutes, Late Registration 9 levels + Break (~4:55 PM), Guarantee $500,000, rule 7 = $140 house fee of $1,100 ($960 to the prize pool), Day-1A-only $40 discount before 10:10 a.m. → $1,060. Sheet 36 (56 Days B+D): 30 minutes, 9 levels + Break (~11:10 PM), $500,000, Day-1B discount → $1,060. Sheet 4 (59 Days A+B+C): 40 minutes, 9 levels + Break (5:55 PM), $150,000, rule 7 = $95 house fee of $600 ($505 to the prize pool), Day-1A-only $20 discount before 11:10 a.m. → $580.
checks.detail: Published rows previously mis-filed the registration figure as level_duration ('11' on 56 1B, '5' on 59 1A), left 56 1A/1B/59 1A without registration close, and truncated the 59 1A name at the rake-discount note. None of the three sheets contains a maximum-entry / no-rebuy / no-add-on clause: rule 8 (a player who bags for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight) limits flights, not entries, so single-entry remains unverified.
checks.action: Corrected in data/c2242cb1/venetian_overrides.json (name, level_duration, registration_closes, conditional_entry_fee) and at the parser root (tools/sync_official_sources.py tail-anchored column split; see B3).

checks.claim: PDF schedule parser root-cause fix (title clock text no longer steals the TIME column)
checks.observed: Before/after diff on the committed capture (data/raw/venetian-dse-iv-schedule.txt): 94 rows both ways; exactly 12 rows changed, every change matching the printed columns on the capture lines (satellites gain printed chips/level; Events 47 1A/1B gain printed chips/level; Events 56 1A/1B and 59 1A gain printed guarantee, reg-close and level and keep their full titles).
checks.detail: The lazy title match used to stop at the first clock inside the title ('RAKE DISCOUNT FOR ENTRIES BEFORE 10:10 AM', '(POKERGO) AT 7:00 PM'), which mis-filed columns. The parser now splits the row from its tail (TIME [REG CLOSES] [GUARANTEE] [CHIPS] [LEVEL]), requires a REG CLOSES clock strictly later than the start, and prefers the split that uses the most printed columns. tools/sync_official_sources.py also applies data/c2242cb1/venetian_overrides.json at scrape time, so the stored snapshot itself carries the corrections (the open hand-off from sessions c2242cb1 / 75757cc1).
checks.action: Gate added: tools/b808eea0_check_dse_live.py asserts the corrected values in both data/schedule-snapshot.json and data/site-events.json.
